title: A 200 OK Is Not a Generation — Evidence Beats Green Checks
description: LTZZZ daily log, 2026-11-24. Our agents returned 200 OK. That only means the channel answered, not that a model thought. Acceptance needs three real things — finish reason, actual model calls, artifact hash. Miss one and we write blocked, not delivered. Three seats (DeepSeek, Doubao, Grok) independently said the same thing today; Qwen returned an api_error and was not backfilled.
